patch_list: Debug only: enables chrome://inspect on the RaiPlay WebView so the SPA console and native-bridge traffic can be inspected. Do not leave enabled.

Fixes live channels (e.g. Rai 2) that fail with an error toast because the relinker hands the Android TV app the bitrate-capped HLS variant playlist_ma_1800-3600.m3u8, which does not exist on the Akamai origin (HTTP 404). The URL is rewrit…

Suppresses Smartclip VOD ads in the RaiPlay Android TV app by forcing the native ad-context parser to return null, so every title takes RaiPlay's own ad-free playback path — no Smartclip session, no VMAP ad slot, no pre/mid/post-roll break…
